description: Package README: what reproduce.py rebuilds and checks, how to run it, the conventions, the folder map (canonical 01b_, superseded-gate folders) and the version notes.

One-command reproduction (python paper7/reproduce.py; no download): rebuilds the board from Corbelli (2014) Table 1 through the frozen kernel and checks every M33 number of Paper 7 v4 (Tables 2, 2b and 3, Appendix A, the prose) at its printed precision, the chain-rule gate, the shipped hashes and expected/ (one PASS/FAIL line per check; exit 1 on any failure).
Refreshes file_manifest.csv (bytes and SHA-256; descriptions kept) and MANIFEST_SHA256.txt; --check compares without writing.
Paper 7 version 3 text as deposited on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.21347359), the source of the v3 PDF; it is replaced by the version 4 text after the v4 deposit.
Keeps results/ (reproduce.py's run outputs) out of git.
Table 2 on the canonical gate at full precision: 8 radial masks x (Hermes t50 6.0, Hermes t50 7.1, MOND): R range, N, chi2nu, chi2 fraction, mean, median |residual| and RMS residual.
Table 2b at full precision: chi2nu as the error floor sigma_int^2 varies (0, 100, 386, 900 (km/s)^2): Hermes (t50 6.0) full, R<=10, R>10 and share of chi2 at R>10; MOND full and R>10.

Table 3 sweep on the canonical gate: Vdisk scale 0.5 to 3.0 in steps of 0.0025, plus steps of 0.0001 within 0.005 of each age's minimum; M/L factor, global M*/L(3.6 um) and g98; Hermes chi2nu (full, R<=10, R>10) and R>10 mean residual at 6.0 and 7.1 Gyr; MOND chi2nu (full, R>10) and R>10 mean residual.

The 11 rows Table 3 of v4 prints, at full precision, with g98, beta and the R<=10 chi2nu at each scale. Each row is evaluated at its printed scale: the minimum row at 1.368, the 3-dp rounding of the fine-grid minimum 1.3677 (at 1.3677 the row's global M*/L, Hermes outer mean and MOND outer mean would print 1.277, -42.58 and 5.12; its chi2nu cells are the same).

Appendix A as v4 prints it (Vgas and Vdisk to 3 dp, the other columns exact). It reproduces every chi2nu cell of Tables 2 and 3 and every prose number except the floor-free Hermes values (Table 2b gives 118.48 and 87.49; the 3-dp table gives 118.51 and 87.54, so not Sec 4's 118); some residual and chi2-fraction cells of Tables 2 and 3 also need the full-precision board. reproduce.py checks A.2 to A.7 and A.11 to A.14.
Every printed number reproduce.py checks outside the tables (prose, constants, Appendix A): check id, location in v4, quantity, full-precision value, printed value, tolerance.
